description: Initiative 0002 Slice 6: reconciliation issues list with an explicit honesty policy (unknown bias) proven on pack_03_mismatch_and_cert_gap and pack_07_scans_rotated_low_quality; not_depicted requires positive evidence of absence and is always cited.

userStories.title: Produce honest reconciliation classifications (unknown bias)
userStories.description: Generate reconciliation issues classified as depicted|not_depicted|unknown with strict evidence thresholds that bias to unknown under uncertainty.
acceptanceCriteria: Reconciliation items use item-level classification depicted|not_depicted|unknown.
not_depicted requires positive evidence of absence that is narrowly defined and cited; otherwise classification must be unknown.
When evidence is weak or ambiguous (especially on pack_07), items are downgraded to unknown; no fabricated negatives.

userStories.title: Unknown issues are actionable (guidance copy)
userStories.description: When an issue is unknown, the UI explains what evidence is missing and what to do next, without leaking internal errors or provider payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue drawer includes guidance copy explaining what evidence is missing (survey callout text, instrument match, etc).
Guidance is specific to the observed failure mode (missing doc, low extraction quality, ambiguous match) and avoids vague 'try again' copy.
If no citations can be locked due to low extraction quality, the row falls back safely to missing_input with remediation checklist.
